title: Interview: Enterprise Sales assignment and voice limit
story: Asha is the sales operations manager at Contoso. She invited you to talk about phone handling for Retail Sales – Voice.
She says callers wait too long and work is not shared fairly. She wants agents to take more calls at once and for Enterprise Sales to get calls in a fair rotation.

interview.opening: We need to handle more incoming sales calls and balance them better.

topics.ask: How many calls should one agent handle during busy times?
topics.answer: I want agents to be able to handle up to three live calls so customers do not wait.

topics.ask: Should calls go to the least busy agent or be shared another way?
topics.answer: Share them evenly. Everyone should get a fair turn, not just the same people.

extras.ask: Do you still want voicemail after hours?
extras.answer: Yes, keep voicemail for after hours so we can follow up.

extras.ask: Do you need simple reports on call volumes?
extras.answer: Yes. A weekly summary is fine.
